info.title: keel
info.description: The call surface of a keel installation, one POST per function: the parameters are the request body and the answer is the envelope around the result. A download function is served on its raw route instead, by GET with the parameters in the query or by POST with them in the body, and streams the file; a stream function is served on its raw route by GET as server-sent events. Generated by keel-dev openapi from the admin dump of the descriptors.
